Done. All three functions are now implemented and exported:

1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** — constrains n to the range [min, max]
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** — formats byte counts with units (B, KB, MB, GB) to one decimal place
3. **`slugify(title)`** — converts titles to URL-safe slugs by lowercasing, trimming, replacing spaces with dashes, and removing non-alphanumeric characters (except dashes)
